faq.question: What is the minimum order for business cards?
faq.answer: Business cards have a minimum order of 500 cards.

faq.question: How long does production take?
faq.answer: Please allow at least 5 business days from when you place your order for production to complete.

faq.question: Can I revise my order schedule?
faq.answer: You may revise your schedule up to 12 hours before the requested completion date.

faq.question: What file types can I upload?
faq.answer: Upload JPEG, PNG, or WebP images up to 10 MB for custom designs.

about.title: Welcome To Namerrs
about.body:
Since 2008 we've been San Jacinto's best local sign, printing, and t-shirt business. From custom business cards and banners to t-shirts, hats, vehicle magnets, and memorial prints, we deliver quality products at competitive prices with fast turnaround.

Our team reviews every custom order to make sure your design looks great in print. Visit us in San Jacinto or order online — we're here to help your business stand out.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Namerrs Signs & Printing respects your privacy. We collect only the information needed to fulfill your order — name, email, phone, and order details. Payment information is processed securely by Stripe and is never stored on our servers.

We do not sell your personal information. Contact NameRRs@gmail.com with privacy questions.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
By using namerrs.web.app you agree to these terms. All custom orders are subject to our production schedule and approval of uploaded artwork. Pricing displayed as $0.00 indicates pricing is being configured — final totals will be confirmed before payment when live pricing is enabled.

Contact NameRRs@gmail.com with questions about these terms.
